scope: Exact bit packing around the existing Boolean switching networks. Verified conditional CSLib execution leaves, two recursive levels, and a complete small countdown. Full original CSLib execution remains unproved.

binaries.note: Production code is identical across these snapshots. An additional cfg(test) untimed-selection regression was added after server binaries were built; it does not affect proof relations or witnesses. Immutable binary copies are used for child-process verification.

record_packing.relation: Injective mapping of selected bits; all omitted full-record input bits and unused packed input bits are constrained to zero. Existing fixed Beneš edges and Boolean selectors are retained.
record_packing.legacy_policy: All nine earlier classes keep their matrices, fixed wiring, quotas, transcript domains and proof envelopes.

paired_comparison.check: Remote cmp of every corresponding .statement completed successfully; first three and later batch 256 also match the previously retained statements locally.

measurement_limits: Worker wall excludes loading, native replay and setup; includes witness generation, proving, verification and proof writes.
Peak RSS includes the whole benchmark process; virtual-address allowances are separate from resident memory.
All runs use a 400 GiB physical-memory cap and no swap. Eight workers allow 1536 GiB of virtual addresses; sixteen allow 3072 GiB.
The sixteen-worker sample covers 32 batches; the paired eight-worker samples cover 16. Do not interpret their rate ratio as an isolated worker-count effect.
Short conditional leaf rates do not measure admission, full byte/hash workload, output, recursive aggregation or complete CSLib execution.

recursive_chain.setup_policy: Fixed original CSLib profile with fuel 16,000,000,000 and three execution leaves; compile approved class and counts before reading proof bytes.
recursive_chain.fresh_mutations: Independently flip bit 0 and bit 127 in each of 57 public words.
recursive_chain.scope: Conditional CSLib execution prefix; source admission and complete execution are outside this chain.

discarded_large_test_attempt.reason: Fresh receiver could not start after a concurrent Cargo build replaced the running target binary. The valid proof and both recomputed clock rejections had succeeded. Repeated the entire test using an immutable binary; fresh verification then passed.

full_run_projection.status: Not proved; this is not a committed runtime or budget.
excludes: extra leaves required by other quotas
